title: Combined Statin and PD-1/PD-L1 Inhibitors in Treating Non-small Cell Lung Cancer

sections.abstract: This prospective observational study was designed to evaluate the safety and efficacy of PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors in combination with statins compared with treatment with PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors alone in advanced NSCLC patients. Participants will receive either immunotherapy + statin or immunotherapy until progressive disease (PD) as assessed by the investigator using Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors Version 1.1 (RECIST v1.1). Treatment can be continued until persistent radiographic PD or symptomatic deterioration.
